title: Maison d’Etto: Where Free-Spirited Equestrian Style Meets Modern Perfumery
summary: Maison d'Etto translates free-spirited equestrian memories into modern perfumery. Discover the brand's fragrances to try through Scentbird samples.
body_markdown:
Fragrance is more than a finishing touch when getting ready to head out; they speak to our emotions, our memories. At Maison d’Etto, it’s[a form of self-discovery](https://www.scentbird.com/blog/may-new-niche-perfume-brands/) , an opportunity to highlight the different facets of your personality. Inspired by founder Brianna Lipovsky’s personal connection to the free-spirited equestrian world, the brand approaches perfumery as a form of storytelling, translating meaningful memories with horses into olfactive experiences.


For those looking to discover distinctive perfume samples on Scentbird,[Maison d’Etto](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/maison-detto) offers a thoughtful collection that feels deeply personal while staying refreshingly modern at the same time. Each fragrance is an invitation to explore a different mood, or maybe even a new version of yourself.


## Maison d’Etto: the free-spirited equestrian philosophy


Maison d’Etto’s connection to the equestrian world goes beyond its visual identity. For founder Brianna Lipovsky, horses represent a unique kind of connection: one that doesn’t rely on words but instead encourages intuition and a deeper understanding of oneself. Naturally, this philosophy carries through the brand’s approach to fragrance.


The brand’s philosophy is particularly evident in its[2026 Year of the Horse campaign](https://maisondetto.com/pages/year-of-the-horse?srsltid=AYCX9vJYF9ggs0PLe7Rsfoi_lJPsE-kC7Ji7UdJfUfPJ3EuOzoBYw5Sk) , which explores the relationship between fragrance, memory, and personal transformation. Drawing on the horse as a symbol of inner strength and self-reflection, the collection introduces eight olfactive archetypes, each representing a different intention or state of mind.


## Maison d’Etto fragrances to discover on Scentbird now


Whether you’re drawn to earthy, outdoorsy notes or something warmer and more introspective, Maison d’Etto offers a variety of fragrance personalities to explore. Here are a few scents to discover through perfume samples on Scentbird.


### [MAISON D’ETTO Macanudo](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/maison-d-etto-macanudo-52633225328993)


Macanudo reimagines vetiver with its modern blend of hay absolute, freshly cut grass, and neroli, evoking the feeling of stepping on a polo field. Grounded yet full of energy, it’s a scent that invites you to step into the outdoors.


### [MAISON D’ETTO Noisette](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/maison-d-etto-noisette-262254427964747)


Noisette is a textured fougère that balances freshness with quiet warmth. It opens with French lavender and orris, while ambrette seed, musk, and amber wrap the fragrance, bringing a sense of calmness to the wearer.


### [MAISON D’ETTO Durban Jane](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/maison-d-etto-durban-jane-169316516559599)


Warm and enveloping, Durban Jane feels like returning home after a long day. Sandalwood, orris, and ambrette blend with playful resins and an unexpected nutty accord, making it an intimate scent that helps you reconnect with yourself and your space.


### MAISON D’ETTO Karat EG


A distinctive, modern chypre built around an intoxicating Turkish rose. Fresh earth and amber add depth and warmth, creating a fragrance that feels both nostalgic and full of possibility. Inspired by the hopeful spirit of new beginnings, it’s a scent for those who are forever at the start of something.


### MAISON D’ETTO Rotano


A bold leather and woody fragrance that balances a distinctive stallion accord with soft suede and cedarwood. Rich and commanding, it’s a scent that evokes inner strength and quiet confidence, made for those who know their direction and move with intention.


## Why try Maison d’Etto perfume samples on Scentbird?


Maison d’Etto is built around the idea that fragrance is deeply personal, making its collection especially rewarding to explore through[perfume samples on Scentbird](https://www.scentbird.com/) . Wearing a scent throughout the day allows its story to unfold, revealing subtle shifts in texture, warmth, and emotion. Whether you’re drawn to the earthy character of Macanudo, the quiet warmth of Noisette, or the boldness of Rotano, sampling the collection is a chance to discover which fragrance resonates most with you.


## Frequently asked questions


### What does Maison d’Etto’s “Year of the Horse” mean?


Year of the Horse is Maison d’Etto’s own 2026 campaign, not a reference to the Chinese zodiac. It’s a moment for founder Brianna Lipovsky to revisit the brand’s roots, reframing its existing fragrances as eight “olfactive archetypes,” each representing a different intention or state of mind tied to the brand’s free-spirited equestrian philosophy.


### Why is Maison d’Etto inspired by horses?


Founder Brianna Lipovsky has an equestrian background, and each Maison d’Etto fragrance is named after and inspired by a specific horse that shaped a meaningful memory in her life, translating that personal connection into scent.


### What does Maison d’Etto Macanudo smell like?


Macanudo is a modern take on vetiver built around hay absolute, freshly cut grass, and neroli, evoking the feeling of being outdoors on a polo field.


### Is Maison d’Etto unisex?


Yes. The brand’s fragrances are designed to be gender-neutral, built around the idea of personal connection rather than being marketed to a specific gender.


### How can I try Maison d’Etto fragrances before buying a full bottle?


Scentbird offers Maison d’Etto fragrances as 8 mL vials delivered monthly, letting you wear a scent for weeks and see how it develops before committing to a full-size bottle.
